name: launch-copy-np
description: Launch copywriting for the Nepal market, built on the fact-locked Copywriting Editor Kit: draft landing, product, pricing and about pages from your facts; edit copy with every price, date and claim kept; diagnose why a page does not convert for Nepali buyers (price, delivery, COD, returns, address, trust); check claims like 'No. 1 in Nepal', '100% original' and 'organic' against your evidence with Nepal rule flags; capture a brand voice covering Nepali, English and Romanized language mix; and adapt copy between English, Nepali and code-mixed Nepali without translation-speak.
